# Graph permissions

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs` from src/registry.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Least-privileged Microsoft Graph permissions per command. `m365 permissions --mode application` prints the
same union for an app registration; `m365 auth login` requests the delegated set automatically.
